rowScopes.scopeRows: reporting units after search · type, before the province selection: the base of the national Aha, the province fill, the province chart

firstAha.scope: whole country (no province selected); a selected province switches to its universities

firstAha.denominator: Σ measure of scopeRows (or of the province)

invariants.rule: students are per reporting unit, summed per province by the unit’s province; never allocated to a campus, polygon, building or district
a site shows at most one unit’s figure, named as the unit’s, with how the link was made; a unit has at most one site
a site without a link shows no student figure — never 0
a province without a unit is a measured zero (outline, no fill) and is listed by name
the Aha never cuts through a tie and never focuses every item holding the measure
every share shows numerator and denominator; the open comparison shows both bases in each bar
fee lines are never summed, averaged, compared or converted; codes read in words; a programme in an announcement is not a programme admitting now
quality is verbatim with dates, never a rank
types bind to LDS series by id with their shape cue; no star
colour scales use all 41 LDS samples by rank, identical HEX on both themes
every panel view ends with exactly one provenance line and carries no caveat
no official roster codes, private links, sheet addresses or credentials in the tree
distances are straight lines between reference points
roster points are context only: never counted, never clickable
